rows.label: Dual Ichor Incarnon Genesis
rows.note: pick it first — Tier 5, not Tier 10

rows.label: Circuit progress
rows.note: Tier 5; the first adapter is enough

rows.label: Circuit progress
rows.note: Tier 10 only if taking Torid as the second weekly Genesis too

conditions: Dual Ichor is only offered during Rotation E (Week 5 in the nine-week cycle); confirm the live offering at Cavalero.
Circuit Progress is banked per completed stage since Update 35.5, but bailing mid-stage still costs that stage.
Excavation and Void Flood are the run-killers — mission order repeats every 7 stages, so a bad stage-3 draw repeats at 10, 17, 24.
bonuses: Torid shares the same Week 5 rotation — farm both Incarnon Genesis picks in one Circuit sitting.
A small, well-built arsenal beats a large one; Teshin's Cave weights its offers toward weapons you already own.

disclosures.title: weekly calendar gate
disclosures.body: Missing Dual Ichor's Week 5 offering means waiting the length of the nine-week rotation, roughly two months, for Rotation E to return. Since Update 39.0, buying it from Cavalero's 120-plat store during its live week includes the install resources too, skipping the Pathos Clamp grind — but it only works during that same window.

groups.sub: Orowyrm finale, Steel Path with the three bonus Undercroft side portals
groups.activity: farm Pathos Clamps for the install
groups.meta: 24 Clamps in one Steel Path run with all three portals
conditions: Pathos Clamps come only from Orowyrm chests and are not affected by Resource Boosters.
The three bonus Undercroft side portals need 7 decrees to enter and only exist in the Duviri Experience, not the Lone Story.
bonuses: Run the Duviri Experience, not the Lone Story — Steel Path with all three portals pays 24 clamps in one run, more than a full install.
Two normal-mode Duviri Experience runs (10 clamps each) can be faster wall-clock than one Steel Path run if you don't also want the arcanes.
The Fragmented Duet boss in Isleweaver drops 10 clamps (15 on Steel Path) if you'd rather skip the Orowyrm entirely.

conditions: Rune Marrow and Kovnik are passive Duviri pickups — you'll likely have both well before finishing the Circuit run that earns the adapter.

disclosures.title: build after installing
disclosures.body: Melee Influence no longer procs off the toxin clouds (Update 35.1); run Melee Vortex with a Magnetic source instead — Magnetic Rush covers the proc and attack speed in one slot. Pair with a frame that strips armor built in, or Saryn.
